review.evidence: Fresh conversation invoked strictly from .keeper-brief.md with zero access to the shaping conversation; audited only on-disk .skeinn/ artifacts, Skeinn CLI outputs, and spot-checked implementation files under apps/web/src/ and apps/server/.

summary: TASK-053 code and Red-Team remediation are honest on disk (zero residual purged symbols, charLore preservation server test real, settings/models/regex/card-edit/surface wiring verified), but the Skeinn handoff fails Crux buildability and anti-laziness checks: skeinn task next points to a parked V1 task (TASK-026), all 7 open tasks have zero guardrails, web-v3-frontier.md directly contradicts already-built theater extra.choices code in TASK-044/theater-extra.test.mjs, PROJECT.md/STRUCTURE.md are split-brained between V1 mobile and V2 web SPA, and distribution-forms.md has zero compiled design/task delta while two active capabilities remain in researching status.

gaps.gap: Broken Work Map and unexecutable first task: `skeinn task next` returns parked `TASK-026` (`[停泊·2026-11-10方向收缩]`, touches only `.skeinn/design/web-rp-form.md`); `TASK-028` is likewise parked-but-open with design-only touches; `TASK-049` stays `open` with `evidence: []` even though all 5 acceptance criteria have completion evidence and `CardAppFrame.tsx:130`/`MessageIframe.tsx:108` already wire `opts.surface` (contradicting `TASK-049` note '待办: web 挂载组件接线'); `TASK-037` still requires killed group chat (`C9 群聊/频道: 砍掉` in `DECISIONS.md:274`/`PROJECT.md:11`); `TASK-035` omits its own P1 blueprint `.skeinn/design/legacy-convergence.md` from `reads`; `TASK-044` reads superseded `.skeinn/design/frontend-binding-matrix.md`; `TASK-050` still specifies abolished dual-sprite `立绘` layout (`web-rp-form.md:19` V2.1) and omits `web-v3-frontier.md`/`web-rp-form.md` from `reads`.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent running `skeinn task next` is immediately directed to start a parked task (`TASK-026`) with no source `touches`, and every other open task either contradicts recorded decisions, is already partially/fully done without closure, or omits the current design docs needed to pick a valid first edit.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Parked tasks (`TASK-026`, `TASK-028`) are blocked with recovery conditions or closed/superseded so `skeinn task next` returns a genuinely active, uncontradicted next Task; `TASK-049` is either closed with verified evidence or split so only remaining unbuilt scope stays open; `TASK-037` removes or explicitly retires C9 group-chat criteria; `TASK-035`, `TASK-044`, and `TASK-050` have accurate `reads` (no superseded docs, including `legacy-convergence.md` / `web-v3-frontier.md` / `web-rp-form.md`) and real source `touches`.

gaps.gap: Anti-laziness #4 (Dropped guardrails) & missing `implements` links on open Tasks: 0 of the 7 open tasks (`TASK-026`, `TASK-028`, `TASK-035`, `TASK-037`, `TASK-044`, `TASK-049`, `TASK-050`) define a `guardrails` array; `TASK-049` and `TASK-050` have `implements: undefined` and `TASK-044` uses a blanket exemption instead of linking concrete design/capability rules.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Specialist red lines from `sandboxed-card-apps`, `frontend-microkernel`, `st-engine-compat`, `storage-engine-semantics`, and `distribution-forms` remain stranded in capability docs instead of reaching the executing Agent's task context, inviting generic defaults or regressions on sandbox isolation, fiber scoping, and engine compatibility.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Every active (non-parked) open Task in `.skeinn/tasks.json` carries 1-3 concrete, testable `guardrails` inherited from its relevant capability/design docs and a valid `implements` target pointing to a `current` design section (or a narrow, justified `design_exemption`).

gaps.gap: Direct contradiction on Theater `extra.choices` server protocol: `.skeinn/design/web-v3-frontier.md` (lines 13, 26), `.skeinn/eval/audit-frontend-placeholders-2026-11-21.md` (lines 41, 148), and `.skeinn/eval/task053-evidence.json` (line 8) claim `message.extra.choices` server wire protocol does not exist yet and requires a separate large task, whereas `TASK-044` acceptance[3] and on-disk `apps/server/tests/theater-extra.test.mjs` + `apps/server/tests/theater-extra-http.test.mjs` prove server-side `floor.extra.{choices,scene,narrator}` passthrough, opt-in `luker_generation.theater|structured` lifting, and `GET /api/utopinn/generate/jobs/:id` `theater`+`choices` exposure are already built.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent starting theater work from `web-v3-frontier.md` or `TASK-050` will treat the server choices wire as non-existent and either rebuild an already-implemented server contract or introduce a conflicting schema.
gaps.evidence_to_close: `design/web-v3-frontier.md`, `eval/audit-frontend-placeholders-2026-11-21.md`, `TASK-044`, and `TASK-050` are reconciled against `apps/server/tests/theater-extra.test.mjs` and `apps/server/src/endpoints/backends/luker-generation.js`, explicitly distinguishing what server wire already exists (opt-in `luker_generation.theater` + `floor.extra.choices/scene/narrator`) from what actually remains (prompt/card schema, frontend consumption/choice UI, or assets/sidecar).

gaps.gap: Split-brained entry documents (`.skeinn/PROJECT.md` and `.skeinn/STRUCTURE.md`): `PROJECT.md` `## Intended result` (lines 5-11) declares V2 = Web SPA official frontend with mobile parked, yet `## Whole experience or behavior` (line 19) and `## Completion and failure` (line 113) still state V1 mobile-first promises and completion criteria; `## Work map` (line 105) still describes '17 个任务 (005→011/006/015→010)' instead of the 52-task map (45 done, 7 open); `## Staged visibility and review` (lines 118-120) still lists completed `TASK-001/008/009`; `## Professional capability map` (lines 87-97) omits 4 of 13 capabilities on disk (`distribution-forms`, `frontend-microkernel`, `storage-engine-semantics`, `cli-client`). `.skeinn/STRUCTURE.md` (lines 5-11) still marks `apps/web/` as `(待建)` and omits `apps/cli/`, `packages/kernel/`, and `packages/panel-shim/`.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent cannot establish current project truth, observable human completion signals, directory placement rules, or the active capability/task map from `PROJECT.md` and `STRUCTURE.md` without colliding with superseded V1 mobile promises.
gaps.evidence_to_close: `.skeinn/PROJECT.md` is updated end-to-end so Intended result, Whole experience, Professional capability map (including `distribution-forms`, `frontend-microkernel`, `storage-engine-semantics`, `cli-client`), Work map (post-TASK-053 active frontier), Completion and failure, and Staged visibility all agree on V2 truth; `.skeinn/STRUCTURE.md` reflects actual packages/apps (`apps/web` active, `apps/cli`, `packages/kernel`, `packages/panel-shim`).

gaps.gap: Anti-laziness #2 (Uncompiled capability delta) & unconfirmed active capabilities: `.skeinn/capabilities/distribution-forms.md` contains real external practitioner research, but its operational rules, anti-patterns, and verification probes (`移动端=纯空客户端`, `桌面端=Supervisor+独立 dataRoot`, `公网空客户端=TLS+认证闸门` incl. `/characters/*` auth) are not compiled into any core Design doc mechanism (`v2-stack-decisions.md`, `admin-surface.md`, or `mobile-fork-ireader.md`) or Task guardrail (only a single passive bullet in `web-v3-frontier.md:79`). Additionally, `frontend-microkernel` and `storage-engine-semantics` remain `status: "researching"` with empty `field`/`scenario` in `skeinn check`, and `mobile-app-stack` remains `provisional` despite Expo being superseded by D-020 and parked.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Capability rules that are neither confirmed nor compiled into Design mechanisms/Task guardrails are ignored by downstream execution; a fresh Agent cannot tell whether `frontend-microkernel` and `storage-engine-semantics` are authoritative constraints or unfinished drafts.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Compile `distribution-forms.md`'s concrete constraints and verification probes into `design/v2-stack-decisions.md` (and `admin-surface.md` public-exposure/auth boundary) and list it in `PROJECT.md`; promote `frontend-microkernel` and `storage-engine-semantics` out of `researching` via `skeinn capability confirm` (with accurate `--source agent|human` and populated scenario) and clarify `mobile-app-stack`'s parked/superseded status so `skeinn check` has zero unconfirmed-active-capability warnings.

gaps.gap: Core design doc completeness and minor evidence/comment hygiene: `skeinn check` reports 5 core design docs missing `## Alternatives considered` (notably `design/core-engine.md`, which is `vs-V2: current`, `Kind: system`); `design/web-v3-frontier.md` still has `Status: shaping` (not active/frozen); `.skeinn/eval/task053-evidence.json:13` names `api/connection.ts` exports as `getModels`/`probeUpstreamConnection` whereas on disk `apps/web/src/api/connection.ts` exports `listModels` (L28) and `testConnection` (L20); `apps/web/src/api/mock.ts:103-109` retains a stale banner claiming models/presets/global-lore/worldbook have no server endpoints; `.skeinn/state.json` `Q-005/006/007` have empty resolutions and `DECISIONS.md` reuses duplicate IDs (`D-013`..`D-021`).
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Does not block starting the first Task once Gaps 1-5 are fixed, but leaves `skeinn check` emitting structural warnings, keeps a newly shipped core experience doc in `shaping` state, and plants misleading function/comment references for future Agents.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Add real `## Alternatives considered` to active `current` core design doc `design/core-engine.md` (and resolve or explicitly reclassify the other 4 `skeinn check` core-doc warnings); finalize `design/web-v3-frontier.md` status; fix the export names in `task053-evidence.json` (`listModels`/`testConnection`) and update the stale `SPEC-DATA` comment in `apps/web/src/api/mock.ts:103-109`.

gaps.gap: Stale/invalidated `prepared_digest` before Keeper handoff: `.skeinn/state.json` froze `prepared_digest` (`b70202f328fbf1df5bfcd9892cac1136118fb1184502d6131b7ed18db15f641f`) at `2026-11-21T08:14:29.131Z`, but `.skeinn/tasks.json` was subsequently modified at `2026-11-21T08:21:24.701Z` (`TASK-053` `completed_at`) without re-running `skeinn project ready`, causing `skeinn keeper record --json-file .skeinn/eval/keeper-result-attempt2.json` to fail with `Error: Project truth changed after skeinn project ready; prepare a new Keeper attempt`.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh read-only Keeper cannot even commit its verdict via `skeinn keeper record` against the handed-off digest because `.skeinn/tasks.json` drifted after `skeinn project ready`.
gaps.evidence_to_close: After absorbing Gaps 1-6 into `.skeinn/`, run `skeinn check` (zero blocking issues) and re-freeze with `skeinn project ready` as the final step before handing off the new `prepared_digest` to a fresh Keeper without further `.skeinn/` edits.
